_note: Railway lines and stations from OpenStreetMap via the Overpass API (https://overpass-api.de/api/interpreter), fetched 2026-11-26. Copyright OpenStreetMap contributors, licensed ODbL 1.0 (https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright). Active railway=rail (usage main, branch or unset) as kind 'main'; heritage and tourist lines (usage=tourism, narrow gauge, preserved) as 'heritage'. Industrial, military and mine lines, yards and sidings excluded. Double track mapped as two ways is collapsed to one line, lines simplified to 150 m, clipped to the local authority outlines of wales.js (0.8 km buffer). Same km frame as wales.js: x=(lon+5.40)*111.32*cos(52.4 deg), y=(53.50-lat)*111.2, coordinates rounded to 0.01 km. Names are OSM name tags: some lines are unnamed or named after the OSM line, not the operator. Overview data only, not for engineering or timetable use.
